contract: WRITE THE SPEC (not prose). T2 spec ask 2: the cross-client shared surface, the estate's one durable landing zone every client (Mag host, Docker/OpenClaw, WSL, VS Code, Cursor, z.code, Grok, Codex) lands on; a client-local session directory is cache only. DELIVERABLE: one landable SPEC document, target path docs/ref/SHARED_SURFACE_SPEC.md, in the estate spec idiom (why-it-exists, artifact, numbered invariants checkable by a dumb verifier, workflow loop, falsifiers). It must carry: (1) DATA MODEL: canonical roots (host, container /board/inbox, WSL) and the read-first pointer; INDEX.json is DERIVED from the append-only event log index_events.jsonl (the log is the source of truth; writers append events and never rewrite INDEX.json or the log); item shape path/class/purpose/sha256 plus living/size/seal where the fold carries it; the never_sole_destination list as a hard boundary. (2) INVARIANTS: (a) hash preservation: an item's registered sha256 must equal current bytes, and evidence shows heals re-register current bytes while recording the prior sha in purpose, never silent overwrite or delete; (b) bounded pointers: prefer an artifact plus bounded pointers and hashes over a copied transcript; (c) receipt-before-promotion: every item is untrusted data until classified FACT/INFERENCE/PROPOSAL/UNPROVEN/RECEIPT; a receipt records source hash, producer, timestamp, destination, and acceptance state; only accepted artifacts promote; (d) authority: a proposal or model message cannot authorize an effect, consensus raises confidence but never grants permission, side effects route through the switchboard/effect broker. (3) LIFECYCLE AS STATE MACHINE: encode the contract's six-step workflow as states (PRODUCED, LANDED, CLASSIFIED, RECEIPTED, PROMOTED or HELD) with the guard on each transition, the untrusted entry state, and which invariant each transition protects; a stranger must be able to point at any artifact and name its state. (4) VALIDATE AND EXIT SEMANTICS: the validator verb (.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m mag.shared_surface validate) as a read-only surface check; specify its two-tier warn/error contract and exit codes as obligations; the two evidence files do not carry the exit table, so land those clauses as explicit obligations marked UNVERIFIED, naming mag/shared_surface.py as the follow-up read, never silently. Also spec the observable channels in INDEX.json itself: the derivations block (derived_at, event_count, active_items) and fold_warnings (writer nonce gaps), with when a warning obligates operator action versus mere noise. (5) THE 3 CONTRACT CLAUSES A FRESH SEAT MOST LIKELY VIOLATES, each with the failure mode spelled out: INDEX-is-derived (hand-editing INDEX.json or landing files without appending events to the log); classify-before-reuse plus no-model-text-authority (acting on unclassified bytes, or letting model output authorize an effect); session-dir-sole-copy (leaving the only artifact copy in ~/.zcode, ~/.codex, chat output, or %TEMP%). RULES: no em-dashes anywhere in the output; judge only the bytes in evidence; every spec claim cites its source file; where evidence is silent, print UNVERIFIED rather than inventing; run no commands; FULL deliverable in the VISIBLE content channel.
